name: Bob Navigation Hotkeys
description: `[S` / `]S` jump to the first task of the previous / next occupied review group, cycling. Ctrl+Shift+P always opens the Task Card, a focused first screen with exact P-level previews. Ctrl+Shift+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `b`: it opens the Task Card's Depends on stage for the task, a Task Link's linked task, or a counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+B>` batch; Esc, q, or Ctrl+[ close it without writing, and its More section opens a property's value stage. Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `⇧B`: it opens the Blocks stage for a task or Task Link, supports counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B>`, and works from Depends-On and BLOCKS lines, where Ctrl+Shift+P on a BLOCKS line also opens the owner’s stage directly. On an inbox task every non-closing answer asks where it goes before writing and moves there. Open and manage related notes, tabs, and task properties, including priority levels that roll scheduled dates. Ctrl+Enter on the card takes the recommended roll, decay, or cancel from the previewed ladder, including counted and Task Link batches. Scheduling a date opens one combined Reason and Work summary review; a Pending or Next task can record an optional Work Log summary as a dated entry under a WORK LOG child. A Cancel action closes tasks as Cancelled with an optional reason kept in a first-child Cancel Log. Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+F prompt Pending tasks for an optional Work summary. A single counted Ready ROTTEN or scheduled TICKLER keep asks why, then stamps and writes one Rotten Log entry in one undo; blank logs no reason given, and Esc cancels. Counted N<Alt+F> and Task Link sessions show one combined prompt when Rotten keep reasons or Pending/Next Work summaries apply; Work summary comes first, followed by Keep reason, and one Enter submits both. Each counted keep gets its own entry; at-limit targets still skip unstamped and unlogged. The decay card shows the logged keeps in its header and its Keep swaps the rows for the same in-card reason stage, committing stamp, increment, and entry in one undo; Esc returns to the choices. On a landed RECURRING row both write nothing, show the recurring-tier notice, and stay. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the review walk just landed on completes it and advances within the group when another live row remains (nav api v3). `]s` / `[s` away from the current review task first return to it. The Task Card level strip and priority notices render the shared signal-bar priority mark through the bob-ledger-tools api.priorityMarks v1 namespace, falling back to the Lucide signal icons without it. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress — asking once for an optional Work Log summary when moving back to Next — through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace. Closing a planned task opens one grouped successor picker when offers exist; nothing starts selected, and the cycler applies only chosen links. The pulled-in summary is shown through nav api.notice v1. Review-row closes append the cycler's additive `successorNotice` line to the walk toast. Journals each counted ]s answer, with its outcome, through the bob-ledger-tools api.stats namespace. Depends-On writes now mirror open dependents into generated 🧱 BLOCKS lines, in the same-note transaction or a checked cross-note follow-up, including counted, marked, Ctrl+D, hand-edit (and undo), conversion, and Ctrl+Shift+M paths. Adding an open prerequisite from Ctrl+Shift+P also removes the newly Blocked task's live links from today's open Pomodoros, deleting an emptied entry. Cmd+Enter on a reading task, Task Link, or managed embed opens its source_pdf in Highlights without vault writes, while other targets retain Obsidian’s new-tab behavior. Turns on Templater's device-local "Trigger on file creation" when it is unset, so Cmd+N and other new notes get the vault's folder template (_templates/new_note.md). Only the BLOCKS chips in bob-ledger-tools use nav `api.blocks` v1, for ＋ and hover ×. The nav api gains an additive `openReferencePdf(path)` member (Promise of `{ok, reason?}`; the api `version` is unchanged) so the bob-ledger-tools Reading Board can hand a reference PDF to Highlights without vault writes. `Z` (mapped in the vault vimrc) or the "Zoom image on cursor line" command opens the image on the cursor line — an embed, image link, or Markdown image — in a read-only full-window viewer with keyboard and mouse zoom and pan; it never writes the vault, and native image clicks are unchanged. Task relations use 🪢 LINKS and generated LINKED FROM rows; nav api.relations v1 opens either stage and removes live links. The Task Card offers Links to (l) and Linked from (⇧L), with Ctrl+Shift+L and Ctrl+Shift+Alt+L commands; on a Task Link they open the linked task's stage in its own note, and on a Depends-On line they open the owner's. CURRENT shows existing links or sources, Enter applies or removes, Shift+Enter edits a relation label, `~` in the filter flips direction, and Ctrl+D clears all outgoing Links to relations while refusing generated Linked from rows. Counted Ctrl+Shift+L applies one target to every selected source; reverse counted links are refused. Alt+P applies the Task Card recommendation in one key, sets P1 on a task with no priority, stays hidden for immediate rolls and decays, and waits on the visible card before cancellation. `]s` landings end their toast with the `Alt+P` roll preview from nav `api.quickRoll` v1. Pomodoro move and rename pickers offer recent task types with component swatches and near-duplicate hints; rename previews count linked task type changes; Ctrl+D hides or restores Recent suggestions only. `]w` / `[w` (mapped in the vault vimrc) walk Pending, Next, and Ready tasks off today's plan — the dash PENDING/NEXT/READY sections — with a lane-colored toast and walk rail; `]W` / `[W` jump to the first task of the next / previous lane, cycling. [n` / `]n` (mapped in the vault vimrc) open the note's previous / next labeled link; `]]` / `[[` repeat the last bracket walk — `]s` review, `]w` lanes, or `]n` links — forward / backward, remembered per device. Ctrl+Shift+- changes the current note's parent: a panel pre-filled with the current parent ranks existing notes, previews the new ancestry, refuses cycles, and rewrites only the `parent:` frontmatter line as a quoted wikilink in one undo.
author: Bryan
